### Notes

What could not be inspected: 1Password does not publish any page that affirmatively denies having a startup program, so absence is established indirectly rather than by an explicit statement. Evidence gathered: https://1password.com/startups, /for-startups and /business/startups all return 404; the business pricing FAQ enumerates its discount categories ('nonprofits and journalists', plus volume pricing) without mentioning startups; the teams/small-business product page mentions startups only descriptively ('1Password offers a range of plans to accommodate businesses of all sizes, from startups to large enterprises') with no offer attached. The only free-access programs found are a 14-day business trial and a free year for GitHub-verified students via the GitHub Student Developer Pack - neither is a startup program. Any private startup pricing would be via 'Contact our sales team'. Re-checked 2026-09-16: 1password.com/pricing/business publishes no startup programme, startup discount or startup offer.
